_about.open_decision: D-07 — the English name for the destination.
_about.requirement: "All destination copy comes from a single content key. Do not scatter the phrase through templates."
_about.resolved: Decided by Nicolas Bürkler on 30 August 2026: the build specification's own §1 phrasing is the phrase, promoted from prose into this key. No new coinage.
_about.why_one_key: This is the phrase most likely to be revised, and the one a template would most naturally inline. One key means a revision is one edit — and means a search for the phrase finds the decision rather than forty copies of its consequence.
_about.usage: Read via `eigentlich.content.destination(language)`. There is deliberately no fallback literal: if this file is missing, the loader raises rather than rendering an invented phrase.
_about.forbidden: R-143 / principle 10 — the destination is stated plainly. Metaphor belongs in the marketing surfaces, never here.
